title: Build a customer revenue mart
description: Give the business a table it can use.
intro: The Silver order table is already typed and ready. Build a small Gold mart that answers a simple question: how many orders has each customer placed, and how much have they spent?
objectives: Keep monetary values exact using the existing DECIMAL amount.
hints: Group by customer_id, count the orders, and sum amount.
Use COUNT(*) AS order_count and SUM(amount) AS total_revenue.
setup: CREATE TABLE silver_orders AS SELECT CAST(order_id AS BIGINT) AS order_id, CAST(customer_id AS BIGINT) AS customer_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount FROM bronze_orders;
